_source:
Fully rebuilt (2026-09-08) against the real, official Curriculum Development Centre materials for Hospitality Management Form 2 -- replacing this file's own earlier same-day build, which had been sourced from a real school's own scheme of work whose topic numbering ('2.1' through '2.13') did not track the official curriculum at all (confirmed by direct comparison, not assumed). Two real, official CDC Teaching Modules were downloaded and read in full: 'Hospitality Management Form 2 Term 1 and 2' (CDC Digital Library, on the library since 03/04/2026, 191 pages) for Terms 1-2, and 'Hospitality Management Teaching Module Form 2 Term 3' (added 06/09/2026, 60 pages) for Term 3 -- both are genuine CDC publications, no individual/school name to strip. The real official structure for the whole year is exactly 6 topics: Term 1 (2.1 Introduction to Hospitality, 2.2 Front Office, 2.3 Housekeeping), Term 2 (2.4 Food and Beverage), Term 3 (2.5 Cosmetology, 2.6 Entrepreneurship) -- confirmed as a genuine mirror of Form 1's own real structure (also 6 topics: Introduction, Front Office, Food and Beverage, Housekeeping, Cosmetology, Entrepreneurship), which strengthens confidence this is the real intended curriculum shape rather than a coincidence.

Every topic/sub-topic name and Specific Competence below is the official module's own real wording, cross-checked against the real 'Hospitality Management Syllabus Form 1-4' (CDC Digital Library, 06/08/2026) where that document's own topic/sub-topic table was legible. A real irregularity is disclosed, not silently fixed: sub-topic 2.3.2 (Cleaning Areas and Processes) is the only one of the 14 real sub-topics in this file whose own source document never states an explicit 'Specific Competence:' line -- its own competency text here is a direct paraphrase of that sub-topic's own stated learning intent ('...learners will identify different cleaning areas and apply correct cleaning processes...'), not invented content. A second real irregularity: the Term 3 module's own sub-topic 2.5.1 misspells 'Competence' as 'Compentence' in its own text -- reproduced correctly here, not as evidence of anything changed about the content itself.

Its own Content/Concept, Learning Activities, Strategies/Methods and Materials/Resources columns are condensed into each sub-topic's own real introduction text rather than reproduced verbatim in full, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled subject in this app.

subject.name: Hospitality Management
subject.description: Hospitality Management syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 2
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 2" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

sub_topics.name: 2.1.1 Economic Effect in Hospitality Industry

competencies.description: Evaluate the effects of the hospitality industry on the economy

sub_topics.description: The hospitality industry is a key driver of economic growth -- hotels, restaurants, travel services and recreational facilities generate income, create jobs and support entrepreneurship. It stimulates infrastructure development (roads, airports, amenities) and has a multiplier effect on agriculture, transport and retail.

sub_topics.name: 2.2.1 Front Office Operations

competencies.description: Apply skills to deliver exceptional front office services

sub_topics.description: Front office as the 'face' of a hospitality organisation -- pre-arrival, arrival, occupancy and departure stages; balancing technical precision (reservations, registration, room assignment) with professional guest service.

sub_topics.name: 2.3.1 Record Keeping

competencies.description: Make use of records in the housekeeping department

sub_topics.description: Records help a housekeeping department work in an organised, accountable way -- attendance book, handing-over report book, housekeepers' room report, lost-and-found book, room checklist, theft records.

sub_topics.name: 2.3.2 Cleaning Areas and Processes

competencies.description: Apply correct cleaning processes to different areas in a hospitality facility

sub_topics.description: Different areas of a hospitality facility (guest rooms, corridors, public areas, conference rooms) each require the correct cleaning process -- sanitising, sterilising, disinfecting, decontaminating, polishing, mopping, vacuuming.

sub_topics.name: 2.3.3 Laundry in Hospitality Facility

competencies.description: Perform Laundry procedures in hospitality facility

sub_topics.description: Real laundry procedures for guest linen (bed sheets, pillow cases, towels, tablecloths, staff uniforms) -- collecting, sorting, pre-treatment, washing, drying, ironing, storage, distribution.

sub_topics.name: 2.3.4 Maintenance
sub_topics.description: Routine and preventive housekeeping maintenance -- checking lights, restocking mini-bars, cleaning guest rooms, inspecting laundry facilities -- to keep a facility safe and in good condition.

sub_topics.name: 2.4.1 Menu Planning
sub_topics.description: Menu planning as the structured process of deciding what food and beverages to offer, how to present them, and at what price -- a menu as a communication tool, marketing instrument and operational guide.

sub_topics.name: 2.4.2 Catering
sub_topics.description: Catering for different functions (social, business, national) -- a growing Zambian industry supporting tourism, cultural celebrations and entrepreneurship, requiring creativity, efficiency and teamwork.

sub_topics.name: 2.4.3 Basic Sequence of Service

competencies.description: Carry out the basic sequence in Food and Beverage services

sub_topics.description: The professional order in which food and beverages are served -- welcoming guests, taking orders, serving, clearing, presenting the bill -- ensuring consistency and guest satisfaction.

sub_topics.name: 2.4.4 Serving of Food and Beverages

competencies.description: Show skillful serving of food and beverages

sub_topics.description: Practical serving technique across formal banquets, casual dining and cocktail receptions, including clearing and resetting a station.

sub_topics.name: 2.4.5 Food Costing
sub_topics.description: Food costing as turning a recipe into a financial plan -- covering ingredient and overhead costs while leaving a margin for profit, essential for both business and household budgeting.

sub_topics.name: 2.4.6 Food Commodities

competencies.description: Employ various food commodities in cookery

sub_topics.description: Classifying food commodities (animal foods, legumes and pulses, vegetables and fruits, fats and oils) and researching market trends to plan healthy, cost-effective menus.

sub_topics.name: 2.5.1 Hair care
sub_topics.description: Practices and techniques to maintain the health, cleanliness, strength and appearance of hair and scalp -- understanding hair structure/properties, identifying common problems, and selecting suitable products and treatments.

sub_topics.name: 2.5.2 Hair Dye and Colouring

competencies.description: Apply hair dye and colouring techniques

sub_topics.description: Changing hair colour using chemical or natural dyes -- differentiating hair colour and dye, applying hair colour, and streaking hair.

sub_topics.name: 2.6.1 Types of Businesses
sub_topics.description: Types of businesses in the hospitality industry (sole trade, partnership, limited business) -- their characteristics, advantages and challenges, to identify a suitable type when planning a hospitality business venture.
